decisions.title: Deep-dig = teach + shape: battery in protocol, value-essence column carries the dig, gate checks header only
decisions.rationale: User ruling: activate proactive digging, not gatekeeping. Shape beats process; exemplars beat rules. Five weak-cell controls; recurrence escalates gate.

decisions.title: Dig content contract = exemplars-as-contract: 3 real case records + one instruction line; perspectives emerge per domain
decisions.rationale: User rejected format logistics and labeled checklists; cases demonstrate good digging; two starter questions are a floor, never a stopping point.

decisions.title: Standing deepen = card-tail line; rounds exempt from follow-up caps, must surface new facts
decisions.rationale: Visibility = usage; D-13 relapse was the missing standing port. Response: exemplar-form dig, card re-presented; user-driven, uncapped.

decisions.title: Value-essence column header = 'Activates'; symmetric fill, names a consumer, distinct from Pros
decisions.rationale: Verb header prompts the cell form directly; noun headers invite abstract value talk. Parenthetical anchor keeps traceability. Gate checks header presence only.

decisions.title: Cards render in message body, responses free-text; tools only for card-free logistics
decisions.rationale: Dual consumers re-read history; tool payloads render unreliably; free text carries composite replies (deepen + steer) that menus cannot.

decisions.title: Card template merges Cons+Risks into one Cons column; modality carried by wording, 5-column card
decisions.rationale: No mechanical consumer reads them separately; boundary proved unstable in practice; width pressure after Activates. Exemplars carry modality phrasing; re-split only on real need.

decisions.title: Plain language = the reply itself, not an added translation layer; narration contract grounds all jargon
decisions.rationale: Replies plain by default, no translation artifacts. Bans unexplained proper nouns, uncommon-noun overuse, opaque abbreviations. Caliber: Chinese at middle-school level, English at CET-4.

decisions.title: Gate activation: spec_gate_version 2->3; v3 = v2 floor + Activates header; v2 specs keep old floor
decisions.rationale: Reuses the proven grandfather pattern; single monotonic integer, zero new fields. P5's own spec freezes under v3 — dogfood day one.

observable_truths.description: A fresh post-P5 THINK dialogue presents 5-column cards whose Activates cells name concrete consumers
